parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that houses internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and rigidity to the dishwasher, holding the racks, motor, and plumbing components securely in place.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components of the dishwasher.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the dishwasher is made of stainless steel and includes a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the washing chamber during operation to prevent water leakage and provides access to load and unload dishes.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a lower hinge, allowing it to open downward and close securely with a latch mechanism.
